_comment: Prompt conditioning. Two variants disambiguate by which KSampler input the node feeds DIRECTLY: `produces KSampler.positive` is the positive prompt, `produces KSampler.negative` the negative. A node reaching the sampler only through a ConditioningZeroOut is not a direct producer, so a zeroed-out negative correctly yields no negative control. The `text` input is often wired from a Primitive* node (see node_types/primitives.json); recognition follows that link to the editable string.
